With one round left the four Venn-region counts truncate at 2; the 4+ splitting pattern stabilizes. For one selected set and two rounds left, independent exact recursion proves the 3-versus-4 reductions, giving truncation (min(a,3),min(b,3)); 16 such pointed two-round types are distinct. Root 3-round type therefore sees exactly S_n={(min(a,3),min(n−a,3)):0<=a<=n}, distinct for n=1..5 and stable for n>=6, establishing iff min(m,6)=min(n,6). Independent implementation recomputed 16 pointed types and the 6 root theories, verifying critical reductions; the universal 4+ bound and finite-state recursive semantics justify the infinite tail.
